heading: What Is Western Black and White Photography?
subtitles: Not a filter. Not a style. A structural decision that changes what the image has to earn.

bridge.title: Western black and white photography begins when tone has to carry the whole image.
bridge.intro: Cowboy portraits, Western narratives, and Native American portrait work all change when color is removed. Shadow, posture, expression, and restraint become the image's structure.
